name: reset_vector
summary: Bootloader/reset entry; does not directly enter application

name: c_startup_low_high
summary: Low and high application copies; stack W15=0x0EB6, SPLIM=0x1FE4, then call 0x3C44/0x9844

name: app_main
summary: Initializes clock/GPIO/timers/UART/PWM/ADC/I2C/calibration, then loops over comms, ADC-derived protection, PWM control, and state machine

name: init_clock
summary: PLLFBD=0x29, OSCCON unlock/clock switch, ACLKCON=0xA740, PTCON2=1

name: init_gpio
summary: Configures LAT/TRIS B,C,D,E,F,G and mode pin behavior

name: init_timers
summary: PR1=0x9C40 and PR2=0x1F40, enables Timer1 interrupt/timebase

name: init_uart1
summary: U1BRG=0x1A, initializes protocol flags and enables UART interrupts

name: start_pwm3_gate
summary: Sets LATC gate, initializes PWM3, clears output hold flags, sets primary enable flag

name: init_pwm4_pwm6
summary: Initializes PWM4/PWM6, PHASE4=0x8214, PHASE6=0x3FFF, PDC6=0x445C, sets enable flags

name: init_pwm4_softstart
summary: Configures PWM4 mode and initial SPHASE/SDC/default control-loop RAM

name: init_adc
summary: ADPCFG=0xF000, ADCPC0..3 configured, pair interrupts enabled

name: load_calibration
summary: I2C2/EEPROM-backed calibration load into 0x0D50..0x0D7B and related flags

name: refresh_calibration
summary: Same EEPROM/config data refreshed when dirty flag indicates update

name: init_i2c2
summary: I2C2CON=0x8200, I2C2BRG=0x018B, enables I2C2 interrupt

name: i2c1_address_select
summary: Uses ADC/port-derived condition and board pins to set I2C1 slave address and enable I2C1

name: uart1_housekeeping
summary: Supervises command-response framing, timeouts, and outbound telemetry

name: uart_send_query_frame
summary: Sends 0x05 + command, arms TX/RX protocol state

name: uart_send_param_frame
summary: Sends 0x50 + command/value, arms TX/RX protocol state

name: uart1_rx_isr
summary: Command frame parser: header, checksum/ACK, writes command register window and calls command handler

name: i2c1_slave_isr
summary: Implements secondary-side I2C register protocol used by the rest of the supply

name: i2c2_master_isr
summary: Services EEPROM/config transactions and bus state machine

name: timer1_housekeeping_isr
summary: Ticks 0x0A30, comm counters, debounce/fault counters, state flags

name: adc_isr_current_pair
summary: Reads ADCBUF6/7 to 0x0EAA/0x0EAC and filtered values 0x0E54/0x0E56

name: adc_isr_pwm6_loop
kind: ADC pair ISR and PWM6 loop
summary: Reads ADCBUF1/2 etc.; adjusts PDC6 and gate/fault flags

name: adc_isr_vbus_pair
summary: Reads ADCBUF2/3 into 0x0A00/0x0A4A and filtered values 0x0A02 etc.

name: adc_isr_aux_pair
summary: Reads ADCBUF8/9/4, filters 0x0A14/0x0A1C to 0x0A1A/0x0A1E, updates flags

name: evaluate_output_faults
summary: Compares ADC-filtered quantities against thresholds and enables/disables PWM/output flags

name: pwm6_control_update
summary: Invokes ADC-derived control loops, duty limiting, and soft-start calculations

name: wait_ticks
summary: Clears 0x0A30 and waits until desired tick count

name: clear_runtime_shutdown_state
summary: Masks 0x09D6, clears several output/control variables and LATD bit1

name: i2c2_transaction_service
summary: Handles timeouts and state transitions for EEPROM/config transactions

name: nvm_unlock_write
summary: Unlocks and starts NVM write/erase operation

name: boot_main
summary: Initializes boot hardware, validates low/high app images, selects 0x0400 or 0x6000, or enters update loop

name: boot_validate_low_app
summary: Checks low image metadata and checksum over 0x0104..0x01FF and 0x0400..0x4FFF

name: boot_i2c1_slave_isr_or_service
summary: Boot update/control protocol for receiving flash chunks

name: boot_timer1_isr
summary: Timeout/watchdog for bootloader update; can fall back to high application
